description: Vessel Density Grid 2013 is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Marine Management Organisation. This dataset contains the average weekly shipping density for the whole of the UK at a 2km grid resolution. Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher Marine Management Organisation. The portal shows 2017-06-07 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
